name: AndyClaw
vibe_summary: A full OpenClaw-style autonomous agent packed into a single Android APK, with deep ethOS/crypto-wallet integration and a local Qwen fallback. Its recent work on provenance gating, tamper-evident ledgers, and compiled UI flows shows unusually serious security engineering for a mobile agent.
best_for: ethOS / dGEN1 device owners wanting a native AI agent
Android users wanting on-device agent with wallet control
Crypto-native users who want autonomous micro-payments
avoid_if: You need iOS or desktop support
You are uncomfortable granting an AI shell and device control
You want a large, mature plugin ecosystem
openclaw_advantages: Runs natively on Android as a single APK, no server or PC needed
Deep crypto wallet and XMTP integration with an autonomous sub-account
Local Qwen2.5-1.5B fallback keeps the agent working with zero balance or no API key
Structural provenance gate and hash-chained audit ledger exceed typical prompt-level defenses
openclaw_disadvantages: Much smaller community and ecosystem than OpenClaw
Full feature set locked to ethOS/dGEN1 hardware
Mobile-only form factor limits general assistant use cases
Grants high-risk permissions (shell, device control) by design
confidence_summary: README and commit history give strong evidence of architecture and security posture, but Reddit matches are unrelated noise and web sentiment is generic ecosystem chatter, so community signals are weak.

overview_markdown:
AndyClaw is an open-source Android port of the OpenClaw concept: a single APK that runs an agentic tool-use loop (up to 20 tool iterations) capable of controlling the device, managing crypto wallets, sending messages, and operating autonomously via a background heartbeat. On ethOS/dGEN1 hardware it unlocks a privileged mode with wallet signing, XMTP messaging, full device and app control, and an OS-managed heartbeat; on stock Android it runs in an open mode using either a bundled local Qwen2.5-1.5B model or a user-supplied OpenRouter/tinfoil API key.

What distinguishes AndyClaw is the rigor of its recent engineering. A provenance gate classifies every run as USER/TRUSTED/UNTRUSTED and every tool by effect, blocking strangers' messages from reaching the agent's wallet at the mechanism level rather than via prompt instructions. It also ships a hash-chained, append-only action ledger with session frame replay, compiled UI flows that replay recorded tasks without paying a model per step, and a zero-balance fallback that reroutes heartbeat requests to the local GGUF model when the gateway refuses for insufficient funds.

Compared to OpenClaw, AndyClaw trades ecosystem breadth and multi-platform reach for deep mobile and crypto integration. It is GPL-3.0 licensed, actively developed by Freedom Factory, and best suited to ethOS device owners and crypto-native users comfortable granting an AI broad device authority.
